configurationModel.authoritativeMerchantRateSurface: Shopify Admin > Settings > Shipping and delivery > Shipping profiles
configurationModel.note: Merchant-owned rates remain authoritative in legacy delivery profiles. Markets must still be inspected for active country and region coverage.

authoritativeConfigurationInventory.credentialBoundary: The existing quotation app was not broadened and returns access denied for deliveryProfiles, markets, locations, and discountNodes.

acceptedTwoVariantCart.scopeWarning: This cart does not establish behavior for other profiles, locations, values, discounts, or destinations.

expandedRepresentativeMatrix.blocker: Fresh authenticated attempts encountered Shopify storefront/Ajax throttling and one HTTP 422 cart-add rejection before a complete matrix could be recorded. The harness now honors 429 retry semantics and stops on partial cart outcomes.

rollbackAuthority.note: Theme list and selective pull prove backup read access. No production write was attempted, and no authenticated Admin session was available to prove restore/delete authority.

profiles: Shopify Admin > Settings > Shipping and delivery > Shipping profiles.
Open every active profile and record its name, assigned products/Variants, fulfillment locations, zones, methods, conditions, providers, and fallback/backup behavior.
Expand every United States zone and explicitly capture contiguous states, Alaska, and Hawaii.
Record every international zone and confirm whether Canada or any other country can receive a method.
For every rate, record type, name, price or carrier, minimum/maximum cart conditions, weight conditions, free-delivery threshold, and applicable locations/products.
marketsAndDiscounts: Shopify Admin > Markets: open every active market and record included countries/subdivisions and sell-to status.
Shopify Admin > Discounts: inspect active automatic and code discounts for shipping discounts or free-shipping effects.
pickupAndApps: Shopify Admin > Settings > Locations and Shipping and delivery > Pickup in store: record every enabled pickup location and preparation time.
Shopify Admin > Settings > Apps and sales channels: identify any app or channel that can inject rates or create a checkout entry path.
rollbackPermission: With the intended release operator signed in, confirm permission to Edit code on MAIN, restore all six prior files/settings, and delete the five manifest paths that were previously absent. Do not execute a change during this check.

releaseDisposition.reason: Authoritative profiles/rates/Markets/discounts/pickup are uninspected, the representative delivery-method matrix is incomplete, and production rollback write/delete authority is unverified.
